knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: VGG 系列研究用小型卷積核增加網路深度。
knowledge.textEn: VGG studied increasing network depth with small convolution kernels.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 在每個3×3後標ReLU與張量尺寸；用顏色畫出三次擴張後的7×7依賴範圍。；6912與27648計數正確，且報告明確區分相同感受野與不同非線性映射。
knowledge.textEn: Mark ReLU and tensor shape after each3×3 layer; color the final7×7 dependency region.; Counts6912 and27648 must match, and the report distinguishes equal receptive fields from different nonlinear mappings.

knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 在相同Cin=Cout=C、不計偏置時，三層3×3參數為27C²；單層7×7為49C²，感受野皆7但函數不等價。
knowledge.textEn: For equal width C and no biases, three3×3 layers use27C² parameters versus49C² for one7×7; both span7 pixels but implement different functions.
